title: Europe, Napoleon to the European Union
description: Links developments in international relations to political, social, cultural and economic change in the leading states of continental Europe from 1800 to the present. Attention to imperialism causes of war and peace, new ideologies, mass politics and society, industrialization and growth in state power.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 240B, HIST 140, HIST 140B, HIST 240.
recommendations: HSTR 240, or 240A and HSTR 240B recommended for students wishing to take advanced courses in European History.
